body: May I go ahead and set the return type to Double and create a PR to fix this issue? I am a new contributor.

Hi @alishahusain :)  I think this would be a good first issue, although I'm not sure the exact behavior we want.  @imotov would probably have an opinion on this issue but he's currently on vacation (back next week).  I think we probably have two options:

- Change the return signature to Double as suggested, although that might just move the NPE somewhere else
- Check to see if extendedBounds is `null`, and if it is, return -/+ `Infinity` for min/max bounds.  E.g. if the bounds aren't set, then that is comparable to having the bounds == positive and negative infinity.  I suspect that's a better option since we won't be returning nulls, although `Infinity` has it's own strange issues too :)

Feel free to work up a PR, we can review it and see what @imotov thinks when he gets back :)  Or you can wait and see what he thinks before getting started.
Thanks! I went with the second option in my pull request here: #64091
@polyfractal yes I think it is +/- infinity because we want extended bounds to have no effect instead of extending to the entire range of double. I left some comments on PR.
